desc:
🌭🔥 Hot Dogs 🔥🌭

Get ready for the wildest co-op chaos ever! You and your partner play as two unstoppable dogs… tied together with a stretchy sausage leash! 🐕🌭🐕
This isn’t just a run , it’s a teamwork test full of crazy pulls, perfect timing, and hilarious wipeouts. Dash through obstacles, swing each other across gaps, bounce off walls, and try not to drag your buddy into disaster! 💥🌪️
⚡ Can you move as one?
Only true duos can master the sausage leash and survive the madness ahead. One wrong move and you’re both flying!
🏁 Bark. Pull. Launch. Repeat.
Prove your friendship is stronger than the sausage and become the ultimate Hot Dogs champions! 🌭👑
